name: decision_decide
description: Make a structured decision using a typed decision model. Supports three question types: 'choice' (classify into one of N options), 'score' (rate on a scale), and 'noul' (estimate a probability 0-1). Uses the system-configured decision provider.

state.description: The context for the decision. Can be a string (e.g. a customer message), an object, or an array of items to evaluate.

questions.description: A map of question_id to question definition. Each question has: type ('choice'|'score'|'noul'), instructions (string), and criteria (choice: {option: description}, score: [level_labels], noul: omit).

type.description: Question type: 'choice' for classification, 'score' for rating, 'noul' for probability.

instructions.description: Natural-language instructions for the decision model.

criteria.description: Choice: {option: description} map. Score: [level_labels] array. Noul: omit.

model.description: Model name override. If omitted, the provider's default model is used.

provider.description: Provider connector ID (use decision_providers to list available options). If omitted, uses the 'decision' role or the first available decision provider.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the decision call. Default: 60.

states.description: Array of state items for batch decisions. Mutually exclusive with 'state'. Each item is evaluated against the same questions in parallel (max 5 concurrent).
